ambiguity_effects.explain: Direct child versus anywhere under the folder are both natural, but no file is in a subfolder of Product Launch here; all Product Launch files are direct children with parent_id 8200, and 8207 is in Old Launches under either reading.

Last-modifier-is-Leo versus most-recently-modified-by-Leo-among-candidates are both natural, but they select the same file here: only 8202 meets the other filters and has Leo Park as last modifier, and all Leo-modified files share the same modified_at.

turn2.differences: No material difference. The author's c1-c5 match the five filters from a careful reading: PDF type, owned by Maya Chen, created by Maya Chen, in Product Launch, last modified by Leo Park.
turn2.naturalness_note: Real users rarely stack four relative clauses for owner, creator, folder, and last modifier and repeat 'that'. A real request would normally name the file. The precision looks constructed to isolate near misses.
